notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Pinnacle Monk and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
